subject: Data homing certification & takedown procedures
messages:
From: s.lee@crestbank.com (Seung Lee)
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Cc: compliance@crestbank.com
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Data homing certification & takedown procedures

Hi Evelyn,

Quick intro — I'm Seung from CrestBank's cloud compliance team. We're evaluating the Dedicated deployment you've provisioned for our pilot and need a short written confirmation on two fronts before our internal audit next week:

1) Data homing: confirm that customer request traffic and inference workloads for CrestBank are anchored to the US-west cluster (DED-042) and do not replicate to other regions except for encrypted backups we explicitly authorize. Please include whether snapshots or emergency replicas could cross regions automatically.

2) Takedown/deletion timeline: outline the steps and expected wall-clock time from a formal data-delete request (tenant deprovision) to complete removal from primary nodes, caches (KV/cache), and backups/snapshots. We need evidence we can provide to auditors (log artifacts or certificate that show purge completed).

Attachments: deployment-map.png (high-level topology), backup-snapshot-policy.md (requested for context).

Appreciate a concise response with action items and expected delivery dates.

Thanks,
Seung Lee
Sr. Cloud Compliance Manager
CrestBank
From: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
To: s.lee@crestbank.com (Seung Lee)
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data homing certification & takedown procedures

Hi Seung — thanks for the clear ask and for the attachments. High level answers below; I've looped in Marissa (Solutions) and Hannah (Security) for the more detailed evidence artifacts.

1) Anchoring & replication model- Our Dedicated cluster DED-042 is configured with region pinning to us-west by default for your tenant. No cross-region synchronous replication is active for customer inference requests or primary model weights.

- Backups: periodic encrypted snapshot copies are stored in a customer-scoped bucket in us-west. We do not schedule cross-region snapshot copies unless explicitly authorized and requested in writing.

- Emergency replicas: failover/DR plans are manual for Dedicated customers unless you opt into our cross-region DR add-on. If a manual DR run is performed, it requires a signed approval and will be logged.

2) Deletion/takedown timeline and artifacts- Typical timeline (nominal):
- 0–2 hours: tenant access disabled and serving endpoints taken out of the routing pool.
- 2–8 hours: in-memory KV caches and ephemeral caches flushed; live model shards deleted from nodes.
- 24–72 hours: background jobs remove tenant data from persistent volumes (subject to current IO backlog).
- Backups/snapshots: retained according to your snapshot policy; once deletion is requested we schedule snapshot purge and prune catalog entries. Complete irrecoverable removal from archival storage may take up to 30 days depending on vendor retention windows — we will provide timeline options if you require accelerated deletion.

Evidence we can provide: purge logs (per snapshot ID), cluster audit trails showing manifest changes, signed deletion statement for the tenant, and a certificate of wipe for on-disk shards.

Action items we propose:
- Marissa: prepare a one-page attestation we can send to auditors with the config flags used to pin DED-042.
- Hannah/Runbook: produce the purge-log example and the steps we'll run for a test deletion (redacted) and a timeline estimate for CrestBank.

Can you confirm whether you want the accelerated snapshot purge (additional fee) or the standard vendor retention path? Also confirm a target date for the auditor deliverable (we can aim for EOD Fri 23 Mar).

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Manager, Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: s.lee@crestbank.com (Seung Lee)
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Cc: compliance@crestbank.com
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data homing certification & takedown procedures

Thanks Evelyn — that level of detail is helpful. We will take the standard vendor retention path for now, but we need the auditor-facing attestation and the purge-log example by COB Thursday, 22 March.

A couple of clarifying Qs from our side:
- When you say "background jobs remove tenant data" — do you mean the persistent volumes are zeroed / overwritten or are filesystem entries deleted and the blocks marked free? The auditors expect overwriting for certain classes of data.
- For snapshots: can you provide a sample snapshot manifest ID format and the corresponding purge log entry so we can map to our internal inventory?

We appreciate the quick turnaround.

Seung
From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: s.lee@crestbank.com
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data homing certification & takedown procedures

Looping in Operations details and examples per Seung's questions. Posting the draft pieces we'll include for auditors: attached is a sample purge log row and a snapshot-manifest-example in the workbook (audit-evidence-checklist.xlsx).

Key technical points:
- Persistent volumes: our standard deletion procedure unmounts the volume, deletes filesystem metadata, and issues a secure trim where supported. For customers requiring overwrites, we offer a Secure-Overwrite run that overwrites blocks 3x; this is part of our compliance add-on and must be scheduled (estimated +8 hours).
- Snapshot manifests: format is RBW-<tenant>-<YYYYMMDD>-<seq> (example: RBW-CREST-20280317-03). Purge log entries include timestamp, manifest id, operator id, and finalState (deleted|failed|archived).
- Audit artifacts we will hand over: purge-log CSV (signed), cluster-audit-trail slice (timestamps + actions), and deletion-certificate.pdf.

Attachments referenced: audit-evidence-checklist.xlsx (contains sample rows), backup-snapshot-policy.md (from earlier).

I'll produce the sample rows and schedule the Secure-Overwrite run if CrestBank requests it.

—Dev
Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: s.lee@crestbank.com (Seung Lee)
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: compliance@crestbank.com, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data homing certification & takedown procedures

Evelyn/Dev — thanks for the thorough responses and the sample artifacts. CrestBank will accept the standard retention route and does NOT require the 3x Secure-Overwrite at this time. Please go ahead and send the one-page attestation and the purge-log sample CSV by COB Thursday (22 Mar).

Also please include the manifest example text for RBW-CREST so our auditors can map it. If you can attach the signed deletion-certificate template, that would be ideal.

I'll hold follow-ups for now and will reach out if the auditors ask for the accelerated option.

Regards,
Seung Lee
Sr. Cloud Compliance Manager
CrestBank
